title: core: an organization-probe store fault in `localizationFallbackReach` reads as `unowned`, so the delivery's missing default currency is graded permanent with no `readFailed`
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Found by the contract review of PR #27730 (#27257), record `6508920767` (should-fix S2; read from the code, not measured). Outside the shape triage accepted for #27257 (`6506866652`), so not on that PR. Sibling of #27710.

## What is wrong

PR #27730 makes `resolveLocalizationContext` (`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`) answer `readFailed: true` when the direct `sys_setting` read throws, and messaging grades a currency-hole render refusal after such a read as retryable. One leg before that read is not covered: `localizationFallbackReach` turns an `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` from the `sys_organization` probe into `unowned`. For a delivery with no organization under a non-wall posture, no `sys_setting` read then runs. The same transient store fault therefore still yields "no default" with no `readFailed`, and the message is dead-lettered as permanent.

## Expected

A store fault on the organization probe is reported the same way as a fault on the settings read: the answer carries `readFailed: true` (without writing the failure memo for a value it never read, or with it, as triage decides), so messaging retries it. Pin it at the resolver and through one channel, as #27730 pins the settings leg.

Re-check after #27730 merges.

Filed without `domain:*`; grading is triage's.
